decision: Select the strongest current Snowflake CoCo CLI Hackathon artifact and expose any reason BidPilot is not first-place-ready.
population_label: Six discoverable exact-event public GitHub submissions in the selected workflow or AI-native application population, plus the current local BidPilot freeze.

information_parity.source_locked_variant: score only observed_evidence and explicitly described repository or deployment behavior
information_parity.parity_reconstructed_variant: score the complete neutral card while discounting unsupported claims

scorer_policy: Three fresh no-history model sessions. Each scores one lane packet in isolation and returns machine-readable JSON.
disagreement_rule: Adjudicate when total range is at least 18 or any official axis range is at least 8.
tie_rule: Prefer higher technical score, then completeness, then lower score variance.
pairwise_plan: Run the top two finalists in both left-right orientations across three fresh replicas and flag position bias above 65 percent.
unscoreable_policy: Report as unscoreable rather than assigning zero.
output_schema: Candidate code, three integer axis scores, total, decisive reason, strongest evidence, largest gap, confidence.
